about_the_game:
The Internet Angel OMGkawaiiAngel joins Desktop Mate! Her bright, energetic streamer persona will light up your desktop.

The signature feature of this DLC is a transformation unlocked when combined with the Ame-chan DLC. If you own both, you can enjoy the scene where Ame-chan transforms into OMGkawaiiAngel—a transformation sequence recreated to evoke the original game, offering a special experience.

The Desktop Mate version of OMGkawaiiAngel includes plenty of flashy, streamer-style motions—such as para-para dance moves and homages to internet memes—packed with her signature charm.

Features

  • All-new 3D model created exclusively for Desktop Mate

  • Sparkling, streamer-inspired exclusive motions

  • Linked transformation feature with the Needy Streamer Overload Ame-chan DLC

Notes

  • Requires Desktop Mate. Please update to the latest version before use.

  • Please follow the “Guidelines for Video Posting/Streaming and Derivative Works of Needy Streamer Overload.”

  • Under these guidelines, you may stream/post videos on YouTube, Niconico, Twitch, and similar platforms.

[This Product Includes]

NEEDY STREAMER OVERLOAD OMGkawaiiAngel
